doctors.name: Dr. Praveen Chandra
doctors.about: Performed first Percutaneous Aortic valve implantation without surgery in India. Author to over 100 articles and reviewer in leading medical journals. Awarded Padma Shri by the President of India in 2016. Dr. Praveen Chandra is a leading Indian Cardiologist and Chairman of Interventional Cardiology at Medanta Medicity, Gurgaon, India. He is recognized as one of the leaders in Angioplasty in the country and is proficient in a lot of new devices and technologies. He has been awarded for success and achievement in the field of medicine with “Padma Shri” in 2016 by the President of India. He has also served as Director of Cardiac Cath Lab & Acute MI Services at Max Healthcare and Consultant Cardiologist at Escorts Heart Institute and Research Center, New Delhi. He is a fellow of the Endovascular Intervention Society of India and the Asia-Pacific Society of Interventional Cardiology. Dr. Chandra has been a distinguished faculty member in various international meetings and was the Organizer and Director of the AMI course held in New Delhi for the years 2005 & 2006. He has published approximately 100 articles, reviews and abstracts in various national and international journals. He has been awarded the prestigious Recognition Award for Success and Achievement in the field of angioplasty in India, 1998. First time in India he did Percutaneous Aortic valve implantation without surgery. He also did the first ever percutaneous mitral valve repair. Both have important implications in our country with the highest number of Valvular cases in the world. He was also the first one who used Angio Jet Thrombectomy Device, started Percutaneous Myocardial Laser vascularization Program in Asia and the First to use FFR & Bioabsorbable stents in India.

He has over two decades of experience, trained at AIIMS, and gained advanced training at leading institutes in the USA, France, Germany, Italy, Hong Kong, and Australia. He has held senior faculty positions at AIIMS, Medanta, and CJW Medical Center (USA), and is recognized internationally for pioneering neurosurgical advancements.

doctors.name: Dr. Manju Aggarwal
doctors.about: Dr. Manju Aggarwal is a senior nephrologist with extensive experience in India and abroad, including at the University of Minnesota, one of the world’s top nephrology centers. She has expertise in treating acute and chronic renal failure, dialysis patients, and renal transplant cases, including high-risk and sensitized transplants requiring desensitization. She combines compassion with precision in patient care.

doctors.name: Dr. Biswajyoti Hazarika
doctors.about: Dr. Biswajyoti Hazarika is a senior surgical oncologist specializing in Head & Neck surgery with more than 16 years of experience. His expertise includes management of tumors and cancers of the oral cavity, nose, paranasal sinuses, larynx, pharynx, thyroid, parathyroid, and salivary glands. He is skilled in plastic reconstruction of resected areas, endoscopic and minimal access surgery, as well as robotic Head & Neck surgery. He has extensive experience from Kidwai Memorial Institute of Oncology, Dr. B Barooah Cancer Centre, Prince Aly Khan Hospital, and Max Super Specialty Hospital, Saket. He has authored chapters in medical textbooks and published research papers in international journals.

doctors.name: Dr. Giriraj Bora
doctors.designation: Joint Chief - Liver Transplantation & Sr. Consultant GI & HPB Surgery
doctors.about: Dr. Giriraj Bora is one of the youngest consultants in the Liver Transplant and HPB Surgery program at Artemis Hospital. A graduate of JLN Medical College, Ajmer, he trained in General Surgery at the same institute, followed by senior residency in GI Surgery at SGPGIMS Lucknow and MCh in GI Surgery at GB Pant Hospital, Delhi. He has been part of over 1500 liver transplants and performed the first liver transplant in the state of Rajasthan, including the first living donor and deceased donor liver transplants there. His special interests include liver transplantation and resections for hepatocellular carcinoma, combined liver–kidney transplantation, and pancreatic surgeries. He has presented at multiple international conferences including ILTS (San Francisco, 2012 & Sydney, 2013).
